description: Fixed outside-map camera toward a cube corner at 1280x720, FOV 90, Default profile, bloom off, and verified SDL_GPU/Vulkan. This checks cube continuity only; it does not prove playable-route sky openings.

review.notes: No visible pinch, star burst, fold, sampling gap, or tonal break at the tested three-way corner. This supports only the tested cube-corner claim.

title: Thunderstruck aurora cube corner
